instructions.content: Capture baseline and changed evidence under the same conditions.
Compare artifacts before declaring a fix.
Capture baseline evidence from a known branch.
Apply the fix and capture changed evidence with identical steps.
If comparison shows unexpected differences, verify identical conditions (URL, viewport, seed data, build mode), check for flaky or animated elements, and re-capture both runs before concluding.
Record pass/fail outcomes and unresolved risks.
Publish a concise report with links to artifacts.
Install the browser runtime with npx playwright install chromium before automated checks.
Ensure the dev server is running and the port is free before running capture-evidence.sh (check with lsof -i).
For compare-evidence.sh problems, verify both baseline and changed directories exist and contain artifacts; re-run capture if incomplete.
NEVER debug without deterministic reproduction steps.
NEVER skip console and network error review.
NEVER compare baseline and changed runs under different conditions.
NEVER close a UI fix without evidence artifacts.
Do not use this workflow for backend-only issues with no UI symptom.
